title: thelypteris × boottii var. multiflora
intro: Thelypteris × boottii var. multiflora, commonly known as the multiflora Boston fern, is a hybrid species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asian cultures, due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and alleviating respiratory issues. The multiflora Boston fern is reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are mainly attributed to the presence of flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, although further research is needed to confirm its full pharmacological potential.
